featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to give feedback regarding the hostel facilities and management. My experience in this hostel has been very disappointing.
Firstly, the behavior of the hostel warden is very rude and unprofessional. Students are not treated properly, which creates an uncomfortable environment.
Secondly, the hostel hygiene is extremely poor. There are many big rats inside the hostel premises, even in the kitchen area, which is very unhygienic and unsafe for students.
Another major issue is the government washroom located near the hostel. It smells very bad all the time, making it difficult to stay comfortably in the hostel surroundings.
Additionally, the hostel is very congested. Proper air and ventilation are not available, and fresh air or wind hardly comes inside the rooms. This makes the living conditions unhealthy and uncomfortable.
I request the management to take immediate action to improve cleanliness, hygiene, ventilation, and student treatment in the hostel.
Very very very bad experience in this hostel☹️

featured_reviews.review_text: Trust me this is the worst of the worst places to stay at. I won't have given any stars because the hostel is nothing but a prison. She assumes she has a lot of power in her hands, and its hell bent on misusing them at so many levels. The way she talks is extremely humiliating and she makes you feel as a beggar. The hostel has unnecessary restrictions, even for going home you need to write so many applications. Apart from the weekdays, on weekends too they don't allow you to stay out after 8 just because it is Ms. Kalavati's day off! Grow up guys!! Even after asking for water, she literally says 'mai nhi chodungi pani' for absolutely no reason. There have been so many days and nights there has been no water to drink or even in washrooms. Kalavati, the guards, all the caretakers here are extremely unsupportive, even for medical emergency they won't let you go out. Please avoid staying at this place as much as possible.
